name: Adé Mensah
bio: Crate-digs in Accra and Lagos. Writes the liner notes nobody asked for and everybody reads.

notes.note: Forty tracks of Accra and Lagos crate finds. The liner notes are longer than some of the songs, on purpose.
Accra on a Friday: highlife on the radio, afrobeat from the car next to you, dub from somewhere you cannot see.
